name: Amber Enterprises India Ltd
title: Amber Enterprises India Ltd - 540902 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue up 22% to INR12,186 crore, but management guides 50–100 bps margin pressure from copper clad laminate, gold and wage costs; net working capital days jumped to 29 from 9 on inventory build.

triggers.label: PCB margin 12–13% vs 16–17% norm
triggers.quote: in PCB, we are at about 12%, 13%. This generally business is about 16%, 17% business

triggers.label: NWC days 9 → 29
triggers.quote: Our net working capital days stood at 29 days as of March '26 compared to 9 days in March '25.

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR1,800–2,000 crore gross
triggers.quote: we will be doing around INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores of overall capex

triggers.label: Net debt to INR700–800 crore by year-end
triggers.quote: you can expect around INR700 crores to INR800 crores of net debt by year-end

guidance.quote: this division is expected to grow by around 40% in FY '27
we remain optimistic of division's growth of 30% to 35% for both FY '27 and FY '28
we expect a margin pressure of 50 to 100 bps at consolidated level
we expect that the industry will be in the range of 12% to 13% growth phase this year
you can expect around INR700 crores to INR800 crores of net debt by year-end

red_flags.label: Working capital days up sharply
red_flags.quote: Our net working capital days stood at 29 days as of March '26 compared to 9 days in March '25.

red_flags.label: Net debt rising again
red_flags.quote: you can expect around INR700 crores to INR800 crores of net debt by year-end

red_flags.label: PCB margin compression from input costs
red_flags.quote: because of CCL and because of gold prices and currency, that is, but they are taking price increases

evasions.quote: because it's a listed entity, we cannot tell.

evasions.topic: Organic vs acquisition split in Electronics growth
evasions.quote: Everything is organic because we've already acquired
